# Save the history ID for later use

import base64

script = '''import zipfile, subprocess, os, sys, tempfile

zip_path = sys.argv[1]
tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()

with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as zf:
    mafft_files = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith('.mafft'))
    zf.extractall(path=tmpdir, members=mafft_files)

with open('results.tsv', 'w') as out:
    out.write('gene\\tparsimony_informative_sites\\ttotal_sites\\tpercentage\\n')
    for mf in mafft_files:
        gene_name = os.path.basename(mf).replace('.mafft', '')
        msa_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, mf)
        result = subprocess.run(['phykit', 'parsimony_informative_sites', msa_path],
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
        if result.returncode == 0:
            parts = result.stdout.strip().split('\\t')
            if len(parts) == 3:
                out.write(f'{gene_name}\\t{parts[0]}\\t{parts[1]}\\t{parts[2]}\\n')
'''

encoded = base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode()
print(encoded)
PYEOF

import statistics

percentages = []
with open('/workspace/batch_pis_results.tsv') as f:
    header = next(f)
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split('\t')
        if len(parts) >= 4:
            pct = float(parts[3])
            percentages.append(pct)

print(f"Number of alignments: {len(percentages)}")
print(f"Min: {min(percentages):.4f}%")
print(f"Max: {max(percentages):.4f}%")
print(f"Mean: {statistics.mean(percentages):.4f}%")
print(f"Median: {statistics.median(percentages):.4f}%")

# Count zeros
zeros = sum(1 for p in percentages if p == 0)
print(f"Alignments with 0% parsimony informative sites: {zeros}")

# Show some stats
sorted_pcts = sorted(percentages)
print(f"\nSorted sample (every 25th):")
for i in range(0, len(sorted_pcts), 25):
    print(f"  {i+1}: {sorted_pcts[i]:.4f}%")
print(f"  255: {sorted_pcts[-1]:.4f}%")

# The median is the 128th value (in 1-indexed sorted list of 255 values)
print(f"\nMedian (128th of 255): {sorted_pcts[127]:.6f}%")
print(f"Rounded: {sorted_pcts[127]:.2f}%")
EOF
